title: Add stable JSON output for audit verify
summary: Add a `--json` envelope for `covenant audit verify` so supervisors can reliably distinguish the integrity report from other JSON artifacts without parsing raw report fields.
expectedFailureModes: `covenant audit verify` remains undocumented as stable machine output while other privileged commands expose a consistent `kind` envelope.
Automation reads the raw report and breaks when fields or formatting evolve without an envelope version boundary.
Live coverage proves the operator path works, but not the `--json` supervisor contract.
